statement: For every simple99-vertex degree14 graph with adjacent common-neighbor count1 and nonadjacent count2, any actual induced subset adjacency H and exact exterior type counts n_i necessarily admit per-copy integer neighbor profiles of outside degree14-|t_i| and type-incidence vector2*1-(H+I)t_i, with own-copy capacities and justified adjacency-bit restrictions. Their directed aggregate edge totals are symmetric off diagonal and even on diagonal and satisfy the corresponding count-weighted degree/incidence equations and zero/full capacities. Mandatory/free copy selection gives exact necessary min/max overlap bounds for every subset of induced points. No equitable partition, completion sufficiency or target occurrence is asserted.

scope.description: Universal conditional exterior-neighbor and directed-edge constraints for any complete Conway99 target, any actual induced point subset, and complete exact exterior type universe; fixed17/834 screens are an application only

assumptions: Simple symmetric binary adjacency on exactly99 vertices, degree14, adjacentCN1 and nonadjacentCN2
H includes every actual induced edge on S; C and X are the actual complementary adjacency blocks
The labelled type universe contains every actual exterior type; unused types may have zero counts
Any supplied bit restrictions are independently justified for two distinct vertices, including equal types
shared_origins: ROOT proposed the CX block equation, directed edge-moment constraints and witness-screen task
Structural independently reconstructed the block proof, directed diagonal convention, mandatory/free subset bounds and the target-edge non-equitable counterattack
Checkpoint independently proposed the finite834-subset row-screen implementation; no implementation or witness was executed here

written_falsification_boundaries: Actual induced H rather than selected edge union
Zero-count types do not require per-copy profiles
One count per off-diagonal cross edge
Equal types interpreted as distinct vertices
Empty pool and residual degree zero
Individual subset passes need not share a selection
Rook9 uses degree4 while retaining the same cross identity
Target edge forces nonuniform type00 profiles
Aggregate feasibility does not verify the outside SRG block

non_equitable_boundary.condition: S is one actual target edge

limitations: Written discovery only; no different-author approval or schema2 verified binding
Bit sets must be justified independently, and a permitted bit is not sufficient for completion
Every subset interval may be satisfied by a different selection; no common neighbor set is constructed
Aggregate feasibility need not realize individual profiles, a simple exterior graph, exterior common-neighbor identities, PSD ranks or a target
An exact screen failure excludes only the given count vector for the fixed induced H and justified bit sets
Numerical infeasibility alone is not proof; any computational veto requires complete declared scope and a sound independently checked certificate or exhaustive proof
No mathematical program, solver, count witness or scientific raw result was read or executed for this paper
Basic block multiplication and aggregate edge bookkeeping may overlap historical work; no novelty claim
